data.gender_notes: Forutan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Forutan is derived from the Persian word 'Farhad-e-Rutan', which means 'the wind of Farhad'. In Persian mythology, Forutan is the name of the wind that carried the beloved of Farhad, the legendary hero, to his eternal rest. This name is believed to signify the power and strength of the wind, as well as the renewal and transformation it brings.
data.spiritual_meaning: Forutan is a name that symbolizes renewal, transformation, and the power of the natural elements. It is a name that can inspire a sense of wonder and awe, and can be a reminder of the cyclical nature of life and the power of the wind to bring about change and growth.
data.etymology: Forutan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Forutan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
